status: Closed — source repair and frozen regression re-verified
area: Evidence command-run canonical telemetry / governed commit identity admission
finding: evidence run passes a task id to its evidence envelope, but normalizeEvidenceCommandRuns did not receive or forward that id into buildTelemetryObservation. Every newly written canonical command-run observation therefore persisted taskId=null, even when the enclosing evidence document and governed task ledger named a single task. The protected-state pre-commit hook correctly rejects this ambiguous evidence when it is staged with a task-history delivery bundle.
expectedBehavior: A command run recorded through evidence add or evidence run must preserve its enclosing task id in canonical telemetry correlation. Direct normalization callers without a task context remain explicitly null; the repair must not alter command-run cache keys, hashes, source-commit binding, or external-run semantics.
evidenceOrRepro: TASK-TMP-0013's governed historical-bundle delivery commit failed with ATM_PROTECTED_STATE_EVIDENCE_FILE_MISSING_TASK_CONTEXT. Its evidence envelope named TASK-TMP-0013, while canonicalObservation inside its command run had taskId=null. The focused command-runs specification first failed on the exact assertion that a normalization request for TASK-EVIDENCE-0001 must emit canonicalObservation.taskId=TASK-EVIDENCE-0001, then passed after the repair.
containment: The repair changes only the current writer path. Existing evidence remains untouched because historical null identities cannot be truthfully inferred or backfilled. A caller that does not provide task context remains null and does not gain implicit attribution.
